title: Balls or Gapes IV: Test Campaign, Batch 1 (turns 1-10 of 20)

turns.title: Welcome to the Crew
turns.text: Mags Thimbleby watches you from behind the bar, her eyes red from crying. Behind her, the door to the Gullet breathes slowly in and out. A goblin bar-back named Splurt stands guard with a mop, doing his best to look brave.

options.label: Ask Mags what exactly the mimic swallowed.

success.text: She counts them off: the beer, the cellar, and Harold, her husband, in his urn. 'Bring Harold back,' she says quietly. 'The beer can stay.'

fail.text: 'Everything,' she says, and cries into a bar rag. Splurt fills in the rest, though not all of it is accurate.

options.label: Inspect the Gullet door.

success.text: The doorframe is lined with teeth, smooth and patient. When the fireplace pops, the whole door flinches. It doesn't like heat.

fail.text: You lean in close and the door licks you. You're coated in warm slobber, and everyone can smell it.

options.label: Talk with Splurt.

success.text: Splurt tells you he's Head of Security, and also Head of Mops. He'll follow you down, he says. He's scared, but he means it.

fail.text: Splurt tells you he's Head of Security, and also Head of Mops. He'll follow you down, he says. He's scared, but he means it.

options.label: Ask the regulars what they saw.

success.text: An old farmer swears the floor sighed just before it swallowed the cellar. It was hungry, he says, not angry.

fail.text: Everyone saw something different, and they argue about it until the fire burns low.

options.label: Say a quiet word for Harold at the hearth.

success.text: Mags watches you, and some of the weight leaves her shoulders. 'He'd have liked you,' she says.

fail.text: Mags watches you, and some of the weight leaves her shoulders. 'He'd have liked you,' she says.

turns.title: Supplies Behind the Bar
turns.text: Mags unlocks a cabinet marked SUPPLIES. It holds everything an adventurer might need, except shoes. Those are sold out, as they always seem to be.

options.label: Shop (opens the store).

success.text: You pick out what you need. Mags rings it up slowly, glancing now and then at the floor.

fail.text: You pick out what you need. Mags rings it up slowly, glancing now and then at the floor.

options.label: Ask Mags for a fair price.

success.text: She takes a gold piece off 'for honest feet,' and nearly smiles.

fail.text: She shakes her head. 'Times are hard,' she says, and the prices stay where they are.

options.label: Pocket a torch while she isn't looking.

success.text: The torch slides into your pack. Splurt saw, and gives you a quiet thumbs up.

fail.text: Mags saw. She adds the torch to your tab without a word.

options.label: Offer to wash mugs in trade for supplies.

success.text: You scrub until the mugs shine. Mags pays you in silver and a nod of respect.

fail.text: Two mugs slip and shatter. Mags waves it off, but she keeps you away from the good glasses.

options.label: Ask Splurt what adventurers usually forget.

success.text: 'Rope,' he says at once. 'And snacks. Always snacks.' He presses a stale biscuit into your hand.

fail.text: Splurt thinks hard, then says 'shoes.' Everyone looks at your feet.

turns.title: Learning the Gullet
turns.text: Before you go down, you need to know what's waiting. A few regulars are still here, trapped like everyone else, and each of them has seen something.

options.label: Buy the old drunk a drink and listen.

success.text: He tells you the mimic has three stomachs. Whatever shines ends up in the last one, and that is where Harold will be.

fail.text: He tells you about his divorce, at length. You learn a great deal, none of it about mimics.

options.label: Map the chambers by listening to the mimic's rumbles.

success.text: Each rumble echoes from a different chamber. By the end you have a rough map. It smells faintly of onions.

fail.text: You have a drawing. It might be a map. It might be a duck.

options.label: Skip the planning and trust your instincts.

success.text: Splurt looks at you with something like admiration. You hope it's deserved.

fail.text: Splurt looks at you with something like admiration. You hope it's deserved.

options.label: Read the tavern's old lease for clues.

success.text: Tucked in the fine print: 'Cellar may contain one (1) dormant mimic. Do not feed after midnight.' You learn where it sleeps.

fail.text: The lease is mostly about noise complaints.

options.label: Ask Mags how Harold liked his beer.

success.text: 'Warm, and too sweet,' she laughs. 'He'd hide a cask near the furnace.' Heat again. You remember it.

fail.text: She can only shake her head. Some memories are too close yet.

turns.title: The Plan
turns.text: Every good rescue needs a plan. Splurt has put on a fake mustache for reasons he does not explain.

options.label: Go in with fire leading the way.

success.text: The mimic seems to hate heat. You light a torch and decide to trust that.

fail.text: The mimic seems to hate heat. You light a torch and decide to trust that.

options.label: Go in quietly.

success.text: In, find the urn, out again. You'll keep to the walls and make no sound.

fail.text: In, find the urn, out again. You'll keep to the walls and make no sound.

options.label: Go in politely, with a bucket of beer as a peace offering.

success.text: Mimics are furniture with feelings, Mags once said. Perhaps it will listen.

fail.text: Mimics are furniture with feelings, Mags once said. Perhaps it will listen.

options.label: Go in with Splurt leading, mop raised.

success.text: Splurt straightens his mustache. 'Head of Security,' he whispers, and takes the first step down.

fail.text: Splurt straightens his mustache. 'Head of Security,' he whispers, and takes the first step down.

options.label: Tie a rope to the bar and go down slowly.

success.text: The rope holds and the knot is good. Whatever happens, you have a way back up.

fail.text: The knot slips on the first tug. You tie it again, slower this time.

turns.title: Stomach One: The Lobby
turns.text: You climb down the throat into warm, damp darkness. A pair of Gut Rats, pale and acid-proof, block the way, gnawing on a swallowed barstool.

options.label: Fight the rats.

success.text: One rat goes down and the other runs. The barstool is yours, if you want it.

fail.text: A rat sinks its teeth into your bare ankle before you drive it off.

options.label: Toss them your snacks.

success.text: The rats eat, and let you pass. One of them almost seems to bow.

fail.text: The rats eat, and let you pass. One of them almost seems to bow.

options.label: Pretend to be a health inspector.

success.text: The rats scatter in a panic, squeaking about paperwork.

fail.text: They don't believe you. One bites you on the way past.

options.label: Sneak past while they gnaw.

success.text: You slip by along the slick wall. The rats never look up from their barstool.

fail.text: A rat squeaks the alarm and nips your heel as you hurry past.

options.label: Scare them off with a torch.

success.text: The rats flinch from the flame and scatter into the folds of the stomach.

fail.text: The rats hiss, unimpressed, and one darts in to bite before fleeing.

turns.title: Stomach One: Lost and Found
turns.text: Here the mimic keeps what it couldn't digest: a single baby boot, a folded letter, and a very angry cat sealed in a jar.

options.label: Free the cat.

success.text: The cat ignores you completely, which is how you know it's grateful. It follows you anyway.

fail.text: The cat scratches your face on the way out. Fair enough.

options.label: Read the letter aloud.

success.text: It's from Harold to Mags, written years ago. Everyone goes quiet. Splurt wipes his eyes. You resolve to bring Harold home.

fail.text: It's from Harold to Mags, written years ago. Everyone goes quiet. Splurt wipes his eyes. You resolve to bring Harold home.

options.label: Try on the baby boot.

success.text: It fits your big toe. Technically, you now own a shoe.

fail.text: You lose your balance and fall. The walls ripple with something like laughter.

options.label: Search the pile for anything useful.

success.text: Under a soggy hat you find a few coins the mimic couldn't stomach.

fail.text: You find a great deal of lint and one very old sandwich.

options.label: Keep the letter safe for Mags, unread.

success.text: You fold it carefully into your pack. Some words belong to the people they were written for.

fail.text: You fold it carefully into your pack. Some words belong to the people they were written for.

turns.title: The Clenched Door
turns.text: Between the stomachs is a round, muscled door, clenched tight. It's best not to think too hard about what it is.

options.label: Use fire.

success.text: The door shudders at the heat and opens. You step through with most of your dignity.

fail.text: You singe your own eyebrows. The door opens anyway, almost out of pity.

options.label: Tickle it.

success.text: It shivers open. You agree, all of you, never to mention this again.

fail.text: It clenches harder. Splurt steps in to tickle it, and it opens for him at once.

options.label: Knock politely and ask.

success.text: It opens. Even inside a monster, manners matter.

fail.text: It opens. Even inside a monster, manners matter.

options.label: Force it open.

success.text: You brace and heave. The door gives with a deep, rubbery groan.

fail.text: The door clenches back and squeezes the breath from you before it lets go.

options.label: Sing to it.

success.text: Your voice echoes softly. The door relaxes, opens, and seems almost to sway.

fail.text: The door does not care for your singing, but Splurt joins in and it opens to make you both stop.

turns.title: Stomach Two: The Bar Inside the Bar
turns.text: The second stomach is a perfect copy of the tavern above, built from living flesh. Behind its bar, a Mimic Mini wearing an apron asks what you're having.

options.label: Order a drink and play along.

success.text: You notice the bottles are teeth. 'Nothing for me, thanks,' you say, and walk on by.

fail.text: You drink it. It is stomach acid with a slice of lime.

options.label: Attack the bartender.

success.text: You flip the counter and it scurries off to sulk. The way ahead is clear.

fail.text: It bites, hard, before you drive it back.

options.label: Tip it generously.

success.text: Even mimics appreciate a tip. It points the way to the third stomach and winks with a drawer.

fail.text: Even mimics appreciate a tip. It points the way to the third stomach and winks with a drawer.

options.label: Ask the bartender about the third stomach.

success.text: It leans across the bar and lowers its voice. 'The big one sleeps under the shiny pile. Don't wake it hungry.'

fail.text: It just polishes a glass that is also a tooth, and says nothing.

options.label: Slip behind the bar while it pours.

success.text: You're past before it turns around. Behind the bar is a passage leading on.

fail.text: It turns and snaps its drawer on your fingers.

turns.title: Splurt's Big Moment
turns.text: Splurt slips on the rug, which turns out to be a tongue, and is hauled up toward the ceiling, which turns out to be a mouth. 'Don't leave me!' he cries.

options.label: Grab his ankle.

success.text: You catch him and pull him down. He hugs you for a long, grateful moment.

fail.text: You both go up, and you both come down hard.

options.label: Cut the tongue.

success.text: One clean cut and Splurt drops into your arms. Above you, the whole tavern groans.

fail.text: You miss and cut your own hair. Splurt falls on you.

options.label: Let him go. He'll come back. Probably.

success.text: Splurt vanishes with a sad little sound. Twenty minutes later he walks in from upstairs, bewildered but alive. Death works strangely here.

fail.text: Splurt vanishes with a sad little sound. Twenty minutes later he walks in from upstairs, bewildered but alive. Death works strangely here.

options.label: Throw the bucket of beer at the mouth.

success.text: The mouth gulps the beer, coughs, and drops Splurt in surprise.

fail.text: The beer splashes everywhere. Splurt drops anyway, and lands on you.

options.label: Call out to Splurt to grab his mop.

success.text: 'The mop!' Splurt jams it across the mouth's teeth and climbs free.

fail.text: He tries, but the mop slips. You both scramble and fall in a heap.

turns.title: The Glint Ahead
turns.text: Through the last throat you see it: the third stomach, heaped with every shining thing the mimic ever ate. At the top, glowing softly, sits Harold's urn. Then something large shifts beneath the pile. To be continued.

options.label: Charge for the urn.

success.text: You gather yourself to run. Whatever is under the pile, you'll meet it tomorrow.

fail.text: You gather yourself to run. Whatever is under the pile, you'll meet it tomorrow.

options.label: Creep along the wall.

success.text: For once your bare feet are an advantage. You move without a sound.

fail.text: For once your bare feet are an advantage. You move without a sound.

options.label: Call out to whatever is under the pile.

success.text: A deep voice answers: 'Who's there?' It has a lisp, and it sounds lonely.

fail.text: A deep voice answers: 'Who's there?' It has a lisp, and it sounds lonely.

options.label: Wait and watch what moves.

success.text: You hold still and count its breaths. Whatever it is, you'll know its rhythm by morning.

fail.text: You hold still and count its breaths. Whatever it is, you'll know its rhythm by morning.

options.label: Send Splurt to scout ahead.

success.text: Splurt salutes, terrified, and creeps forward. Brave goblin. You'll be right behind him.

fail.text: Splurt salutes, terrified, and creeps forward. Brave goblin. You'll be right behind him.
